FOR CLAUDE CODE & CODEX

The work merged.
Clear the worktree.

Ten worktrees. Seven merged last week.
And a folder full of handoffs nobody reads.

Lumberjack checks what landed, removes eligible worktrees, and keeps their branches. Working docs can go to trash; research and unfinished work stay.

Install Lumberjack ↓Try a sweep ↘

MIT licensed · Git + Python 3.11+ · No runtime packages

CHECK THE EVIDENCE. KEEP THE BRANCH.SCROLL TO TRY IT ↓

    codex/eng-42-loginThe local branch stays, even after cleanup.

    Work in progress. The worktree and its documents stay.

    Waiting for the merge.

    Squash or rebase merge? Logged-in gh can verify the exact tip of a merged PR. Patch similarity alone never triggers automatic removal.

    INSTALL

    Put it to work.

    Install for your agent, run setup in the repository, then review and commit the changes. The next session start runs the sweep.

    REQUIREMENTS

    Git + Python 3.11 or newer.
    gh is optional, for pull-request evidence.

    Full installation guide ↗
    IN CLAUDE CODE
    /plugin marketplace add VforVal/lumberjack
/plugin install lumberjack@lumberjack
    THEN, IN YOUR REPOSITORY/lumberjack:setup

    Answer the setup questions. Review git diff and commit the generated configuration.

    IN YOUR TERMINAL
    codex plugin marketplace add VforVal/lumberjack
codex plugin add lumberjack@lumberjack
    THEN, IN CODEX

    Run /hooks once to review and trust the plugin hooks. Restart Codex, then choose lumberjack:setup from the skill picker. Review git diff and commit.

    Standard-library Python. No runtime packages to install.

    Before enabling cleanup, see the plan with sweep_worktrees.py --preview.
